text:
Nina Alvarez: Heads-up — product wants console-derived sampling to be first-class. server team will start preferring `x-rw-sampling` structured payloads. this will impact SDKs that currently emit `x-rw-sample: true/false`. need a low-friction migration path.
Samir Rao: What's the exact new shape? full JSON blob? stringified? will proxies choke?
Nina Alvarez: New contract: `x-rw-sampling` should be a JSON string like "{\"source\":\"console\",\"rate\":0.15}". older boolean form still accepted during transition.
Elliot Park: That's a shape and encoding change. TS/Py/Go clients will need to stringify object. risky for customers using raw HTTP clients.
Tara Liu: Platform proposal: accept both decoded JSON objects and legacy booleans; emit metric `sampling_shape.observed` with labels `legacy|structured`. Keep acceptance mode for 60 days then switch to WARN then 30 more days to ERR.
Samir Rao: SDK plan: ship a helper `setSampling({source: 'console', rate: 0.15})` that does stringify for you. default behavior stays legacy to avoid surprise. opt-in opt-out flags per client. we'll add telemetry event `sdk.sampling.emitted` with `format=legacy|structured`.
Nina Alvarez: Devex: console needs a per-org toggle "Prefer console sampling" plus a small note about SDK versions. Also add a migration checklist and expected log lines.
Elliot Park: Code examples — Python: ```py
# explicit structured sampling
client = RedwoodClient(...)
client.set_sampling({'source': 'console', 'rate': 0.15})
```
Nina Alvarez: TS: ```ts
// opt-in to structured sampling
const c = new RedwoodClient()
c.setSampling({ source: 'console', rate: 0.15 })
```
Tara Liu: Go: `func (c *Client) SetSampling(ctx context.Context, opts SamplingOpts)` where SamplingOpts has Source and Rate. Keep it in minor release. no breaking changes.
Samir Rao: Agree — additive API only. we'll mark packages: py 0.14.2, ts 1.6.0, go v0.7.3. include migration note in CHANGELOGs.
Elliot Park: We should also add a runtime warn when server receives legacy boolean after migration window and include tenant id so support can contact. privacy check ok?
Tara Liu: perms ok, just tenant id hash. platform to emit `sampling.migration.warn` event.
ops-bot: policy-service canary deploy starting: v3.15 -> staging. dashboard: https://ci.redwood/d/9999 :rocket:
Nina Alvarez: Proposed timeline: PRs this week, SDK releases next week, console toggle + platform acceptance now -> warn at +60d -> error at +90d. update product + support by EOD.
Samir Rao: I'll create PRs: py #509, ts #811, go #202. I'll add tests for header encoding.
Elliot Park: I'll draft the migration doc and a short runbook for support (how to detect increased WARNs and roll back).
Nina Alvarez: Thanks — let's sync after canary is green.
